watchlist.name: Ritual
watchlist.contract: Native on RITUAL chain (ID 784); BSC & Base 0x256Ea35422b2F36B24aC1D66159Fe69e75918C37 (official tokenomics page; CoinGecko lists no platform contract)

milestones.text: Mainnet + TGE; Coinbase RITUAL-USD spot from day one
Community airdrop claim window start (pre-approved addresses only)
Public audit publication

watchlist.evidence: Founders Niraj Pant & Akilesh Potti (ex-Polychain); $25M Series A led by Archetype (CoinDesk, Fortune, The Block); Coinbase spot listing from Oct 26; insiders locked >=12 months; 18% unlocked at launch.
watchlist.risks: No public audit found; thin volume; uncapped supply (~5% issuance); ~30% below Oct 29 high; Foundation admin powers at launch; sybil-pruning complaints.

watchlist.name: NeoSoul

milestones.text: Gate listing / trading start
Gate Launchpool for DNA ends

watchlist.evidence: AI trading-agent workbench (NeoTrade); $11M pre-A led by MH Ventures with Amber Group, 0G Foundation and others (Aug 2026); listed on Gate, KuCoin, Bitget, MEXC and others.
watchlist.risks: Only one co-founder named; X account created Mar 2026; no audit; revenue self-reported; ~13% float vs FDV; funding coverage is mostly press releases.

watchlist.name: Axis Robotics

milestones.text: TGE; Coinbase, Upbit, Bitget, KuCoin day-one listings
Sell-off: OTC counterparty sold locked ecosystem tokens (counsel reviewing)
MEXC Airdrop+ for AXIS ends

watchlist.evidence: Physical-AI teleop data platform live since Mar 2026; tier-1 day-one venues; 1B fixed supply; team/investors 12-mo cliff + 24 mo vest.
watchlist.risks: Oct 28-29 sell-off of ~42M AXIS (ZachXBT flagged suspected insiders; Axis blames an OTC counterparty breaching a lock-up); no audit; legal-entity mismatch; no named team; phishing look-alike 'airdlrop' domain circulating.

watchlist.name: Fraction AI

milestones.text: Admission to trading per EU MiCA white paper

watchlist.evidence: AI agent competition platform; Halborn audit; Fraction AI Foundation in EU MiCA register.
watchlist.risks: No allocation, vesting, float or venues published; date only from a regulatory filing; backers not independently verified.

watchlist.name: Quantus
watchlist.contract: qtc.omft.near (NEAR Intents asset); native on Quantus L1

milestones.text: Mainnet launch
Trading opened (NEAR Intents)
Tier-1 CEX listing

watchlist.evidence: PoW L1 with NIST ML-DSA (Dilithium) signatures and ML-KEM; co-founders Christopher Smith & Joseph Mattia; round led by Balaji Srinivasan with Babak Nivi, Mert.
watchlist.risks: 27% genesis premine (23% insiders, 1-yr lock + 36 mo linear); no tier-1 CEX; no audit found; FDV ~18x market cap.

watchlist.name: Quip Network

milestones.text: Quests & Mindshare campaigns close
Chain audit -> mainnet -> TGE

watchlist.evidence: Postquant Labs; CEO Colton Dillion, CTO Dr. Richard Carback named; Oak Security audit of swap/signature/smart-account contracts; testnet 27K+ PQ wallets, 1,500+ nodes (self-reported).
watchlist.risks: TGE undated; chain audit not done; uncapped supply (40M/yr emissions); points conversion rate unpublished; incentivized mindshare posting.

watchlist.name: Dataline

milestones.text: $10.6M seed announced; public sale planned on Uniswap CCA (Base)
Uniswap CCA public sale: pre-bidding 'opens soon', no date
Token launch targeted by end of 2026

watchlist.evidence: Data network for AI agents (formerly Tearline), ~50 data sources (self-reported); $10.6M seed co-led by Lattice and Dispersion with Coinbase Ventures, Anagram, Symbolic, Vlad Tenev (The Block); co-founder Nuo Shi named.
watchlist.risks: No tokenomics, sale size, price or date published; ticker confusion (official X says $DAT, some outlets say DLINE); X has 315K followers but very low engagement; no audit.

watchlist.name: TermiX

milestones.text: TMT TGE: no date announced

watchlist.evidence: Agent-to-agent job marketplace with on-chain escrow live on BNB Chain mainnet; backed by YZi Labs (per its X bio and Bit.Fan).
watchlist.risks: Only 0.30% of supply disclosed (Kaito creator pool); no TGE date, supply or vesting; points plus referral farming; impersonators soliciting 'investments' (project's own Oct 28 warning).

watchlist.name: Verona (ex-XION)

milestones.text: Fermi v32 mainnet upgrade: ML-DSA-65 and SLH-DSA-128s account signatures
Phase two: validator keys to ML-DSA-65

watchlist.evidence: Not a new token: the existing XION chain (Burnt Labs; Multicoin, Animoca-backed per CoinGecko) shipped NIST post-quantum account signatures on mainnet Oct 28; open-source release on GitHub; added to CoinGecko Quantum-Resistant category.
watchlist.risks: Not a new launch; validators/consensus still classical; low 24h volume; about 47% below its June high; tokenomics and audit not checked in this sweep.
